title: Execution Record
description: One event in the Execution Ledger — the platform's operational audit layer, introduced in DC-003-I008. Records HOW the system executed (this event), independent of WHAT it produced (see Finished Carousel Object). Distinct from the pre-existing, still-unconsumed execution-log.schema.json (a DC-003-T002 single-aggregate-record design) — see README 'Operational layer' for the relationship between the two.

execution_id.description: Matches execution-log.schema.json's own execution_id pattern and DC-003-I007's ExecutionMetadata.executionId — the same trace identifier is expected to be carried across all three.

sequence.description: Must increase monotonically within one execution_id. Enforced at append time by the Execution Ledger (src/execution-ledger.mjs), not by this schema alone — a single record has no visibility into its siblings.

status.description: Canonical internal vocabulary only — never a provider-specific status string.

data.description: Event-specific, non-sensitive payload (e.g. a carousel_id). Opaque here, same treatment as templated-payload.schema.json's 'layers' — the valid shape is per-event-type, not a schema concern.

diagnostics.description: Allowlisted, not blacklisted: additionalProperties is false, so any field not explicitly listed below (an API key, an Authorization header, an environment variable, a raw provider response, a stack trace) is rejected by schema validation, never filtered after the fact.
